parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器的ID，用于BGP等协议中标识路由器。

set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 20.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 20.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 2001:db8:1::2 peer-as 200

set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 20.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 20.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 2001:db8:1::2 family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 20.explanation: 配置BGP邻居的IPv6单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group EBGP type extern.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] type external
set protocols bgp group EBGP type extern.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP type external

set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPO.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPORT-NETWORK
set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPO.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的导出策略。

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3]/[parameter4] exact
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-NETWORK term 1 from route-filter 2001:db8:5::5/128 exact
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件，精确匹配指定的IPv6路由。

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-NETWORK term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.explanation: 配置策略语句的动作，接受匹配的路由。
